title: Does Humidity Raise Blood Pressure? What Adults 35+ Should Know
description: High humidity can spike systolic BP by up to 10 mmHg in adults over 35—especially with existing hypertension. Learn how to monitor and protect yourself.
reasoning: A summer heatwave is driving real-time searches from adults 35+ experiencing unexplained BP fluctuations on humid days—they want practical, non-clinical answers about weather-related triggers and immediate self-management steps, not textbook physiology.
